title: Desert Canyon Dream
content: So, I've been experimenting with Lucid Dreaming. Last night the LD sent me to a desert canyon/desert setting that looked a bit like this? I was looking up a canyon wall or at a "desert land formation" ever thing was tan/beige maybe a little red tinged with scrub brush,desert pine trees and some medium sized desert willows here and there. Sometimes the wind was blowing. I could see the trees and the shrubs blowing in the wind. The sky was a beautiful, vivid blue with white puffy clouds. It was peaceful and serene. I was fascinated by it and my surroundings.
